alternatives.charge-beside-element.png: Experimental charge placement east of the heavy-element glyph; actual displayed electron pairs retained. For vertical stacks this uses element half width + label gap + charge half width, at element center height.
alternatives.charge-beside-hydrogen.png: Earlier uniform placement beside every stacked H/count; retained for historical comparison and superseded by conditional placement.

outcome: Both uniform policies were superseded: prefer a clear position near the charged heavy element, and fall back alongside the combined H/element label only when atom-centered positions are crowded.
